page.overview:
What is Trenzalore?

Trenzalore is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who, on the card The Doctor's Tomb.

Trenzalore was a human colony planet, where the village of [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Christmas_(town) Christmas] was located. Christmas contained the last remaining crack in space-time, through which the Time Lords broadcast [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/The_Question the Question] and triggered the [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Siege_of_Trenzalore Siege of Trenzalore]. In one timeline, the Siege ended with the death of the Eleventh Doctor and the transformation of [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/The_Doctor%27s_TARDIS his TARDIS] into his tomb.
